sentences.en: Sometimes machines can make an unconscious person breathe for years.
sentences.zh: 有时候机器可以让一个无意识的人呼吸好几年。

sentences.en: Eventually the salesman persuaded me to buy the expensive machine.
sentences.zh: 最终，推销员说服我买了那台昂贵的机器。

sentences.en: The expensive machine turned out to be of no use.
sentences.zh: 结果那台昂贵的机器毫无用处。

senses.zh: 机械，机器；机械般工作的人；机构
